message.frontiersurvival.no_settlement: No loaded Frontier settlement within 64 blocks. Find a hamlet or watchtower charter.
message.frontiersurvival.guard.melee: I patrol these walls. Help against bandits, and leave the residents unharmed.
message.frontiersurvival.guard.archer: I cover the approaches. Stay behind the walls when danger comes.
message.frontiersurvival.refused: Your reputation precedes you. I will not trade until you make amends.
message.frontiersurvival.donation_hint: Hold 16 wheat, 8 bread, or 3 iron ingots and sneak-right-click me: +5 local trust and 1 emerald, once per settlement per world day.
message.frontiersurvival.donation_used: You have supplied this settlement today. Return after 24000 world ticks have advanced to the next day.
message.frontiersurvival.donation_done: Supplies received. One emerald for your trouble; the settlement remembers.
message.frontiersurvival.help: Find fortified hamlets and watchtower outposts in new Overworld chunks. Right-click their gold charter or a guard to see local reputation. Quartermasters trade; sneak-right-click with supplies to earn trust. Defeat nearby bandits to earn trust. Harm residents and lose it. Trusted: 20; Champion: 60; trade refusal: -15; Outlaw: -30. /frontier reputation shows nearby standing.
